name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: US–Iran war in stalemate; Qatar talks continue as threats of new strikes grow
state: The war that began with US–Israeli strikes on Iran on 28 Feb continues with a US naval blockade and Iranian attacks on shipping. Qatar-mediated talks ran on 30–31 Oct; Trump said on 31 Oct talks were 'fine' but suggested an attack could follow the 3 Nov midterms. Iran demands an end to fighting on all fronts including Lebanon. WFP cut Gaza food aid for 500,000 people on 19 Oct.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to much of the region; follow its travel advice and airline updates.
rubric_hit: Active interstate war with attacks on shipping = Alert

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
